blockers.title: Verifier does not independently reopen primary rollout bytes
blockers.effect: Fresh task, route, exact packet, final messages, prohibited activity, and call identities remain driver assertions rather than independently recomputed evidence.

blockers.title: Qualification compares an unchecked freeze-digest string
blockers.effect: Two runs could share an arbitrary digest without proving identical candidate and dependency bytes.

blockers.title: V4 equivalence dynamically executes an unbound baseline harness
blockers.effect: The claimed 93-cell and downstream equivalence dependency is mutable outside the declared closure.

next_revision_scope: Independently lstat, hash, parse, and semantically recompute every primary rollout JSONL in the verifier.
Bind a fixed external freeze manifest path/schema and validate exact candidate/dependency bytes at admission, terminalization, and two-run qualification.
Add the exact v4 baseline harness to the enforced dependency closure or replace dynamic execution with immutable receipts.
preservation: Candidate-v5 bytes and this failed audit remain immutable evidence; repair proceeds only in candidate-v6.
